title: Phavai Data Lab
metaTitle: Phavai Data Lab: Free Running Gear Research Tools
description: Use free, source-linked running gear tools for GPS battery planning, trail-shoe fit and terrain matching, and headphone specification comparisons.
intro: Interactive tools that turn scattered specifications and review evidence into a clearer next step. AI organizes the data; Ben Yardley checks the sources, assumptions, and limits before publication.

resources.title: Ultramarathon GPS Watch Battery Planner
resources.description: Test race time, starting charge, finish reserve, and contingency against separate manufacturer-published GPS modes.

resources.title: Trail Shoe Terrain & Fit Matrix
resources.description: Narrow ten researched trail shoes by terrain, forefoot shape, cushion, distance bias, and drop—without turning fit into a fake universal score.

resources.title: Running Headphone Specification Database
resources.description: Compare fit format, weight, single-charge battery, case totals, resistance rating, controls, and awareness approach.

principles.title: Inputs stay visible
principles.body: Every output shows the assumptions that produced it, so you can change the decision instead of trusting a black-box answer.

principles.title: Claims stay attached to sources
principles.body: Manufacturer facts, independent tests, and owner observations are labeled separately rather than blended into one unsupported claim.

principles.title: Uncertainty stays on the page
principles.body: Conflicting measurements, older generations, and evidence gaps remain visible. The tools narrow research; they do not manufacture certainty.

method: AI assists with organizing source material, normalizing fields, and checking internal consistency.
Ben Yardley reviews the published inputs, calculations, evidence labels, cautions, and links.
Interactive results run locally in the browser. No account, upload, or personal profile is required.
Retail links stay outside the tools so a commercial destination cannot change the result.
limitations: These are decision aids, not hands-on product tests, medical guidance, or safety guarantees. Manufacturer specifications can change, personal fit varies, and real-world battery life depends on settings and conditions. Follow the linked source trail and verify the exact model before buying.
